name: veloverify
description: Check phone numbers with HLR and number portability lookups from your VeloVerify account.

interface.longDescription: VeloVerify checks phone numbers from your VeloVerify account. See whether a number is live, which network serves it and whether it was ported, for one number or a list. You can also see your balance, usage and prices. Paid lookups ask for confirmation and are off until you allow them when you connect.
